description: This file defines classes, functions, and data structures related to game replays in the Battle for Wesnoth project, including replay management, undo functionality, and network synchronization.

classes.name: verification_manager
classes.description: Manages verification of units, constructed with a unit_map reference.

classes.name: replay
classes.description: Handles game replay data, including commands, undo, and playback control.

classes.name: replay_undo
classes.description: Provides undo functionality for recorded moves, undoing on destruction unless confirmed.

classes.name: replay_network_sender
classes.description: Manages network synchronization of replay data.

methods.name: replay()
methods.description: Default constructor for replay class.

methods.name: explicit replay(const config& cfg)
methods.description: Constructor initializing replay with a specific configuration.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the current configuration of the replay.

methods.name: set_save_info
methods.description: Sets the saved game state information.

methods.name: get_save_info
methods.description: Retrieves the saved game state information.

methods.name: set_skip
methods.description: Sets the number of turns to skip.

methods.name: next_skip
methods.description: Advances the skip counter.

methods.name: skipping
methods.description: Returns whether skipping is active.

methods.name: save_game
methods.description: Saves the current game state with a label and configuration.

methods.name: add_start
methods.description: Adds a start command to the replay.

methods.name: add_recruit
methods.description: Adds a recruit command with unit index and location.

methods.name: add_recall
methods.description: Adds a recall command with unit index and location.

methods.name: add_disband
methods.description: Adds a disband command for a unit.

methods.name: add_movement
methods.description: Adds a movement command between two locations.

methods.name: add_attack
methods.description: Adds an attack command between two locations with a weapon.

methods.name: choose_option
methods.description: Selects an option by index.

methods.name: add_label
methods.description: Adds a label at a location.

methods.name: add_rename
methods.description: Renames a unit at a location.

methods.name: add_break
methods.description: Adds a break in the command sequence.

methods.name: end_turn
methods.description: Marks the end of a turn.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Adds a speech or message to the replay.

methods.name: build_chat_log
methods.description: Builds a chat log string for a team.

methods.name: get_data_range
methods.description: Retrieves a range of replay data, filtered by undoability.

methods.name: get_last_turn
methods.description: Retrieves data for the last specified number of turns.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last move.

methods.name: start_replay
methods.description: Begins replay playback.

methods.name: get_next_action
methods.description: Retrieves the next command/action in the replay.

methods.name: pre_replay
methods.description: Prepares the replay system before starting.

methods.name: at_end
methods.description: Checks if replay has reached the end.

methods.name: set_to_end
methods.description: Sets the replay position to the end.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the replay data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the replay is empty.

methods.name: add_config
methods.description: Adds a configuration to the replay, with optional sent-mark.

methods.name: ncommands
methods.description: Returns the number of commands.

methods.name: mark_current
methods.description: Marks the current command position.

methods.name: add_pos
methods.description: Adds positional data for movement or attack commands.

methods.name: add_value
methods.description: Adds a value parameter to the replay commands.

methods.name: commands
methods.description: Returns the list of commands.

methods.name: add_command
methods.description: Adds a new command to the replay command list.

methods.name: get_replay_source
methods.description: Returns the singleton replay source object.

methods.name: do_replay
methods.description: Performs replay of game data, updating display and game state.

methods.name: replay_undo
methods.description: Class for undoing a recorded move, reverts on destruction unless confirmed.

methods.name: replay_network_sender
methods.description: Handles network synchronization of replay data.
